name: 古藤行者
subject: An ANCIENT VINE WALKER, lean full humanoid woven from grey-brown roots and dark green vines, a hollow wooden mask face, two long vine arms and two clearly separated root legs; sparse burgundy leaves.

name: 迷霧飛蛾
subject: A MIST MOTH, complete large nocturnal moth with a fuzzy plum-brown thorax, two broad muted grey-violet patterned wings, four small curled leg tips and feathery antennae; tiny pale green eyespots.

name: 蕨葉獵手
subject: A FERN HUNTER, full agile forest creature with a narrow bark mask, tawny moss-fur torso, fern fronds on shoulders, two clawed arms and two digitigrade legs, a short dark-wood hooked spear held in both hands.

name: 森岩巨像
subject: A FOREST ROCK COLOSSUS, complete broad grey stone body with moss-filled cracks, an ancient carved face, two massive stone fists and two sturdy jointed legs, a few worn ochre runes.
